title.narrative: Open Factory - Supporting innovation platforms and generating socioeconomic and open access opportunities for enterprise, research and innovators' ecosystem in Egypt

description.narrative: OpenFactory (OF) is a 3 years project aiming to create a transformational and collaborative ecosystem and to develop a consistent, comprehensive and coherent approach as unique opportunity for EGY manufacturing sector (particularly the textile-clothing and leather MSMEs), innovators and makers to test and scale new vibrant partnerships, to seed and accelerate eco-sustainable/digital business models, production processes, products avoiding, when possible, to create any new organisations that may duplicate existing resources and efforts while building upon what already exists.

comment.narrative: An initial roadmap must be prepared at the start of every year. Then adopted according to needs

Adoption of the Yearly roadmapaction plan for innovation under OF framework. Policy recommendations relevant sector strategies and good practice achieved. Targets will be also provided updated over the first months of the project work plan through WP2 activities.

The final plan started as follows Starting Companies awareness of laws and regulations affecting the production process. There are many training courses on designing developing textile leather products. Holding conferences exhibitions To discuss changes and trends in the field of design. To exhibit new products. To gather stakeholders to develop a policy supporting the development of the two sectors. Develop a portal for the companies in the two sectors to communicate. Develop an ecommerce platform for companies in both industries. Produce many business models to fit each worker in the two sectors. These models consider both green economy and using ICT. There exist some organizations that gives longterm loans to buy new technology. IMC together with the two chambers give consultations.
